title: Modern C++ Versions and Compatibility
learningObjectives: Explain the main ideas of Modern C++ Versions and Compatibility.
Identify the language rules and relevant C++ constructs.
Apply the topic in a small program.
Recognize common pitfalls and safety concerns.
Test an example and justify design decisions.

understand.concept: C++ standards evolve over time (C++11/14/17/20/23). A feature needs compiler support and the selected language mode. __cplusplus reports selected mode but is not a complete feature checklist.
understand.whyItMatters: Selecting a standard deliberately makes builds reproducible and avoids unsupported features.
understand.explain: Set the language standard in build settings, distinguish compiler version from selected mode, and avoid nonstandard extensions when portability matters.
